requirements.text: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience—is required.
5+ years of experience in growth analytics, web analytics, experimentation, data science, decision science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing customer journeys, conversion funnels, and large clickstream datasets using Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics, or a comparable platform.
Strong SQL skills and experience using Python, R, or similar tools for statistical analysis and modeling.
Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, along with the judgment to work with incomplete data and questions without an established solution.
Ability to identify important questions, synthesize findings, communicate with senior leaders, and help teams turn analysis into decisions.
Experience with web-to-product adoption, cross-surface customer journeys, causal inference, incrementality measurement, or generative AI products is helpful but not required.
